summary: Quantum Cyber N.V. filed an 8-K under Item 1.02 to report termination of an at-the-market issuance sales agreement with Maxim Group LLC, effective June 7, 2026. Prior to termination, the company sold 3,280,927 ordinary shares for net proceeds of approximately $4,388,515. No termination penalties apply. This is a routine contract termination, not a special-situation event. The filing is a Dutch-registered foreign private issuer reporting a standard ATM program closure; no deal terms, premium, or strategic shift are involved. What to watch: no arb angle, purely administrative.
